provenance.construction: One [[6,4,2]] distance-amplification step (Liang, Gu, Chen, Eisert, Wang, arXiv:2609.37231, Eqs. (14), (15); amplifier checks G_X = G_Z = the all-one row of length 6) applied to the board entry codes/96-16-12.json ([[96,16,12]] two-block code over a group of order 48; d_X = d_Z = 12 certified in certs/96-16-12.json), keeping all of its checks.X except the rows [1, 9, 18, 25, 32, 33, 38, 43] and all of its checks.Z except the rows [4, 5, 6, 11, 40, 41, 42, 47] (linearly independent, 40 and 40 rows). Qubits: central (q,a) -> 6q+a (q a base qubit, 0 <= a < 6); t_j -> 576+j for the j-th kept Z-check z_j; s_i -> 616+i for the i-th kept X-check c_i. X-checks: (c_i,a) = {6q+a : q in c_i} + {s_i} (i, then a), then (q) = {6q,...,6q+5} + {t_j : q in z_j} (q = 0..95); Z-checks: (z_j,a) = {6q+a : q in z_j} + {t_j}, then (q) = {6q,...,6q+5} + {s_i : q in c_i}. n = 6*96 + 40 + 40 = 656 = 7n - k of the base, k = 4*16 = 64, check weight 11.
provenance.notes: Distance: d_X = d_Z = 24 exactly: d_P = 2 d_P(base) for P = X, Z by Lemma 4 of arXiv:2609.37231 (proof in the coordinates of this entry: Proposition 4 of amplified-and-folded-codes/README.md, github.com/TimoKellerMath/quantum-error-correction @ c203901854da), and d_X = d_Z = 12 for the base is certified in certs/96-16-12.json (tropidist b03ec2d4077f, level solver). Witnesses: u (x) (e_0 + e_1) for the witnesses u of codes/96-16-12.json. Filed as upper_bound with these witnesses: the board earns the exact tier only through certs/, and its certifiers do not reach d = 24 at k = 64. The construction and the base are published; at board commit 8042f9da no CSS entry dominates or equals this code in (n, k, d, w), and no entry has its n and k unless named here; checked, not equivalent to an existing entry.
